title: Time-Series Anomaly Detection
description: Identification of point spikes, contextual anomalies, and collective trend breaks in temporal sequences.
conditions: Chronological sequential telemetry, event counts, or financial transaction streams
Data exhibits underlying trend, seasonality, and noise components
recommended_methods: STL decomposition residual thresholding (3-sigma on residual series)
Exponential smoothing confidence bands (Holt-Winters prediction intervals)
Rolling median absolute deviation (Rolling MAD) window thresholding
selection_rules: If series has strong periodic seasonality, decompose via STL first and detect anomalies on the residual series
If real-time streaming detection is required, use rolling exponential smoothing bands
Classify anomalies into Point Anomalies (single spike) vs Level Shifts (sustained step change)
limitations: Lag in rolling windows can delay detection of sudden structural breaks
Holidays and planned events must be masked out to prevent high false alarm rates
